name: Favorite Food

angles.text: This shows everyday life in Orgrimmar, where tradesfolk and families look after the capital's children and make sure they are fed.
In Orgrimmar, Borstan turns crispy smoked hog belly cracklings into a flavorful seasoning for daily meals.

aliases: who is the kid behind grommash hold
faq.answer: Migi is a young resident of Orgrimmar who plays with friends behind Grommash Hold. His parents worry that he gets so caught up in play that he does not eat enough, so they arrange daily lunches from Borstan's Meats.
Borstan of Borstan's Meats gives it in Orgrimmar. He prepares a varied meal after learning that Migi's parents worry about the boy's eating habits.
faq.q: Who gives the quest Favorite Food?

faq.answer: Migi can be found behind Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar, playing with other local children. They often pass along the road to the stronghold and recognize Borstan's daily meals by their scent.

aliases: what does migi like to eat
faq.answer: Migi loves the sweetglazed hog belly sandwich made in the smoker at Borstan's Meats. When the smoker is running, its aroma draws him toward lunch behind Grommash Hold.

aliases: why not sweetglazed sandwiches every day
faq.answer: Migi's parents ask Borstan to vary his meals so their son will learn to enjoy more than one dish. They want him to eat enough without relying only on sweetglazed pork.
faq.q: Why do Migi's parents request different meals?

aliases: how does borstan get migi to eat
faq.answer: Borstan crumbles leftover crispy glazed cracklings into a topping for different dishes. Its familiar sweetglaze flavor helps Migi enjoy the varied meals.
faq.q: How does Borstan get Migi to eat different foods?

faq.answer: Borstan's Meats is a smokehouse and butchery in Orgrimmar. Borstan smokes hog belly sandwiches and prepares packed meals for city residents, including neighborhood youths.

sections.body: Behind Grommash Hold, young Migi and his friends spend their afternoons playing along Orgrimmar's dusty paths. His parents worry that he often neglects his meals and does not eat enough. So they ask Borstan's Meats to prepare daily packed lunches. They insist that Borstan vary the meals, hoping Migi will learn to enjoy more than one favorite dish.
sections.title: An Appetite for Play

sections.body: Migi loves sweetglazed hog belly sandwiches and comes for lunch when the smokehouse fills with their sweet aroma. Borstan finds a way to honor his parents' request while keeping Migi fed. He crumbles the leftover crispy glazed cracklings into a savory seasoning that can be sprinkled over any dish. Behind Grommash Hold, the topping persuades Migi and his companions to pause their play and share lunch.
sections.title: The Sweetglaze Compromise

summary: In Orgrimmar, Migi's parents worry that play keeps him from eating enough. Borstan of Borstan's Meats prepares varied lunches with a taste Migi loves, so he and his friends stop to eat.
